results.title: Was haben wir gelacht
results.overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

results.title: Fairy Tale: Fairy School
results.overview: The world has become aware of the existence of all fairies. Due to the ensuing chaos, the Fairy Queen uses magic to erase the memories of mortals. Furthermore, the training of young fairies will no longer take place on Earth, but at the Fairy School in the Fairy Realm. Dudu, Betüş, Perihan, and Pakize take up positions at the school; however, other magical forces await them there.

results.title: Dingo
results.overview: An 81-year-old undiscovered street photographer prodigy, named Dingo, and his daughter confront how photography affects their memories and grief.

results.title: A Fire There
results.overview: In an isolated village in the high plains of southern Georgia, three lifelong friends from the Armenian community discuss their future.

results.title: Mi Amor
results.overview: Romy is a French DJ touring the sun-bleached and club-lit Canary Islands, until her friend vanishes. Met with evasion from locals and the authorities, her search leads her to a magnetic stranger and the sinister proprietors of an exotic animal sanctuary.

results.title: First Step
results.overview: As the 100th-day memorial for her younger sibling approaches, 62-year-old Tan Man Moy joins a line-dance community in Petak Enam. As happiness slowly finds its way back into her life, she must confront the guilt of enjoying life again without the person she loved most.

results.title: Sister of Mine
results.overview: Ten-year-old Noel wants to be more like her older sister, but after a visit to the hairdresser, sudden jealousy arises and sibling rivalry comes to the surface.

results.title: The Best Summer
results.overview: Immersive POV camera footage reveals electric performances, candid interviews, and intimate backstage life with the Beastie Boys, Sonic Youth, Foo Fighters, Pavement, Rancid, Beck, The Amps, and Bikini Kill — an all-access view inside an era-defining moment in music.

results.title: Second Nature
results.overview: Filmmaker Bridget Ikin examines intimate home videos to explore her personal history and the complex bond she shares with her mother in this deeply emotional and candid autobiographical documentary.

results.title: The Great Smog of London
results.original_title: Et Londres disparut dans le brouillard
results.overview: For five days in December 1952, a thick smog suffocated the British capital causing the death of thousands of Londoners. The health catastrophe lead to a realisation, in Britain and around the world, that air pollution was a serious threat to human health. This documentary reveals what happened, hour by hour, in one of the worst peacetime disasters of the 20th century.

results.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 13
results.overview: The thirteenth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on August 8, 2026, at Yokohama Budokan in Yokohama, Kanagawa, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between OSKAR and Callum Newman.

results.title: Unseen

results.title: Asad
results.overview: A slave in 19th Century Egypt revolts against his masters for equal rights for slaves to live freely.

results.title: KitKatClub: Kinks of Berlin
results.overview: The story of the legendary Berlin club and its founder, a woman whose life is inextricably interwoven with the bright and dark sides of a hedonistic lifestyle.

results.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
results.overview: Like shining stars, TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s fourth world tour 'ACT : TOMORROW' unfolds as a dazzling journey toward the tomorrow they promised together. From its beautiful storytelling to the stunning production and powerful live performances that captivated MOA around the world, experience the immersive energy of TOMORROW X TOGETHER’s spectacular world tour on the big screen!

results.overview: Francisco, a 35-year-old filmmaker who secretly works for a delivery app, has a date in Belgrano with Belén, 28, whom he has just met. As he tries to impress her, they both discover a deep and unexpected connection.
